title: Matchmaking lobby store with heartbeat expiry
name: Matchmaking lobby store

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code manages the expiry of lobby keys? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The host stops sending pings and nobody calls join or leave. Roughly when does the lobby disappear?
choices: Never, because the open-lobbies set still references it
Right away, because heartbeat deletes it
About 120 seconds after the last successful heartbeat (or after creation)

questions.prompt: What does onHostPing return when a ping arrives just after the lobby key expired?
Why does leave pass "XX" when it writes the lobby back?
choices: To make the write atomic with the earlier get
To refresh the TTL to its full length
To stop leave from recreating a lobby that expired after it was read
To make the write fail if another player joined in the meantime
